A letter from me to you

To my favorite person

My Amolty,

Happy Birthday, my love!

I don't even know where to start, because there are so many things I want to tell you, and sometimes words just aren't enough to express how much you mean to me.

I wish you could see yourself through my eyes, even for a moment. You'd understand how special you are to me, how much I appreciate you, and how lucky I feel to have you in my life.

I want you to know how proud I am of you: proud of the person you are, your strength, your kindness, and every little effort you make. I hope this new year brings you closer to all your dreams and gives you countless reasons to smile.

I want to see you achieve everything you've ever dreamed of. I want to celebrate your victories, support you through difficult days, listen to your endless stories, and share all the little moments that make life beautiful.

I hope we get to create thousands of memories together, discover new places, experience new things, and one day look back at everything we've been through and smile.

I don't know exactly what the future holds, but I know that I want to be part of yours. I want to see you grow, succeed, and become everything you've always wanted to be.

Thank you for being you. Thank you for every laugh, every conversation, and every little moment that makes my life better just because you're in it.

And if I could make one wish for myself today, it would be to keep making you happy, to keep being a reason behind your smiles, and to remind you how loved and appreciated you are.

Happy Birthday, Amolty. ♡

You're one of the most beautiful things that ever happened to me, my favorite person to share my days with, and someone I'll always be proud of.

I love you more than words can explain.

I'd still choose you. Every single time. ♡

Made especially for Amolty ♥
